purpose: Human/AI parameter worksheet. Resolve local paths or artifact references and pass CLI arguments; verify_connection.py does not read this file with --config.
notes: notBefore is the recorded start of this actual connection attempt, with an explicit time zone; do not backdate it to reuse an old success.
nativeLogUtcOffset describes the native log at capture time, including any daylight-saving offset; do not assume the reviewing computer has the same zone.
After a restart, discover the new Player PID and verify the same intended PlaceId and UniverseId.

The verifier selects PID only in the native log. An operator or trusted live tool must separately establish that the Player log and diagnostic capture belong to that same process; passed alone must not open the operational gate.
A passed report corroborates recorded execution evidence, not current live connection health, complete export, or original gameplay.
If earlier diagnostic output already exists, retain it and bind a fresh capture/tools directory with prepare_capture.py; do not delete evidence or rerun the old diagnostic into it.
Keep filled worksheets, real reports, logs, credentials and game assets outside the public skill repository.
